description.subtitle: Real Madrid adidas football ball in size 5 - white
description.tagline: Show your passion for Real Madrid
description.intro: The adidas Real Madrid Club Talla 5 ball is perfect for fans who want to bring the spirit of the white club to every training and informal match. Inspired by the colors and details of Real Madrid, it combines a striking design with a sturdy construction to enjoy football on any surface.
key_benefits: Real Madrid Shield: Show your passion for Europe's most laureate club.
Machine stitching: Higher wear resistance and long service life.
Butyl chamber: Excellent air retention for constant performance.
Talla 5: Medida oficial para entrenamientos y partidos.
